cards: Revenue share with your school, outside NIL deals, local and national partners: we negotiate every one, and Ryan reads every line. You never have to negotiate with your own coaches.
Schools can pay players directly, up to $21.58 million per school in 2026-27. How a school splits it is up to the school, and the terms vary a lot.
Since April 2026, NCAA rules let college athletes hire agents for their deals, and NCAA guidance lets them bring a representative into revenue-share talks with the school.
Outside NIL deals of $600 or more go through the College Sports Commission's NIL Go. Deals without a real business purpose get rejected. We structure them to clear.

The NCAA's new age-based model (five years, no redshirts) applies to players who first enroll in fall 2027. You enrolled before that, so you get whichever rules are better for you: the old clock with a redshirt year, or the new five. Adopted June 23, 2026.
The portal, only if it's right

We will never push you into the portal. Most of the time the right move is getting paid right where you are. If a move is right for your career and your fit, we're ready on day one: one window, Jan. 2–16, 2027, plus a separate window if a head coach changes.
We look for marketing deals at home and nationally, sized right for now and built to carry into the NFL.
Buyouts, exclusivity, social-media clauses, what happens if you transfer or get hurt. Ryan reads every line before you sign.
